description: Funding pairs ranked by what they actually made over the last 7 days at a given size per leg: the funding each pair paid (recorded hourly, not today's rate) minus taker fees to open and close both legs (Angler's fee included) minus both order books' slippage at that size (sampled every 15 minutes on Hyperliquid, Lighter, Lighter RH, Aster, Pacifica, Phoenix and TxFlow). Pairs without a week of history or a book sample are left out. Each can be run as a funding bot on Angler's Bots page.

min_volume_usd.description: Minimum 24h volume of the asset in USD. Default 1,000,000; 0 includes thin markets.
